scripts.build: npm run sync:figma && npm run pack:components && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:components: vite build --config vite.library.config.ts && tsc -p packages/react/tsconfig.json && node scripts/package-font.mjs
scripts.pack:components: npm run build:components && npm pack --workspace @slatex/react --pack-destination public/packages
scripts.lint: oxlint src packages/react/src packages/react/library.ts scripts tests vite.config.ts vite.library.config.ts
